localized_grid_outage.agent_action: Confirm with grid_available and neighbours; log; notify operator with affected houses; mark zeros as real outage. Type A: record battery state + expected autonomy. Type B: mark house without supply.
localized_grid_outage.human_decision: Dispatch repair crew; decide restoration; approve isolation / re-energising

sustained_undervoltage.agent_action: Classify as network event (all houses sag); flag; notify; keep readings unchanged; track duration. Type A: note battery vs grid supply.
sustained_undervoltage.human_decision: Any network action: tap change, load reduction, feeder reconfiguration, transformer inspection

transformer_overload.agent_action: Flag; compute loading and time above 100 %; notify. Type A: propose holding the house on battery while SoC allows. Type B: notify only.
transformer_overload.human_decision: Approve relief action; dispatch inspection; decide load shedding; plan capacity upgrade

battery_charge_failure.category_text: REAL EVENT (home equipment) - physical state changed
battery_charge_failure.agent_action: Flag; compare charge with available PV; mark SoC unreliable; notify. Device rule unchanged.
battery_charge_failure.human_decision: Inspect BMS / inverter / charge controller; approve remote restart; replace

battery_discharge_failure.category_text: REAL EVENT (home equipment) - physical state changed
battery_discharge_failure.agent_action: Flag (HIGH priority if essential load unserved while SoC high); log unmet demand; notify.
battery_discharge_failure.human_decision: Inspect BMS / inverter; approve remote restart or reset; replace

pv_partial_shading.category_text: REAL EVENT (home equipment) - physical state changed
pv_partial_shading.agent_action: Flag; check clear-sky ratio and neighbouring PV to separate shading from cloud; advisory note.
pv_partial_shading.human_decision: Inspect and clean panels (sand/dust); check shading source

meter_frozen.category_text: SENSOR / DATA PROBLEM - physical state unchanged
meter_frozen.agent_action: Flag; mark channel stale; advisory estimate (type A: inverter/PV/battery as 2nd source); quarantine; request retransmission.
meter_frozen.human_decision: Technician or approved remote meter restart; check communication

meter_dropout.category_text: SENSOR / DATA PROBLEM - physical state unchanged
meter_dropout.agent_action: Flag; mark channel stale; advisory estimate; quarantine; request retransmission (read-only).
meter_dropout.human_decision: Technician or approved remote meter restart; check communication (GPRS/PLC)

meter_drift.category_text: SENSOR / DATA PROBLEM - physical state unchanged
meter_drift.agent_action: Flag; estimate drift trend; advisory correction factor on a separate channel (raw kept).
meter_drift.human_decision: Recalibrate or replace meter; approve any applied correction

meter_noise.category_text: SENSOR / DATA PROBLEM - physical state unchanged
meter_noise.agent_action: Flag; advisory smoothed signal on a separate channel (raw kept).

meter_bias_current.category_text: SENSOR / DATA PROBLEM - physical state unchanged
meter_bias_current.agent_action: Flag; advisory corrected value (type A: only while importing).
meter_bias_current.human_decision: Recalibrate sensor / CT; approve correction factor

voltage_sensor_fault.category_text: SENSOR / DATA PROBLEM - physical state unchanged
voltage_sensor_fault.agent_action: Flag; quarantine voltage channel; compare with neighbours / transformer voltage.

falsified_under_report.agent_action: Flag ONLY; keep evidence (energy-balance gap, residual trend); never conclude theft.
falsified_under_report.human_decision: Field inspection under the legal procedure (STEG); billing correction

falsified_replay.agent_action: Flag; quarantine channel (exact 24 h match); notify security.
falsified_replay.human_decision: Security check of meter and data path; field inspection
